baselineNote: Bench gate baseline. Adopted 2026-09-07 from the 7.6 gate run docs/phase-7/gate/runs/2026-09-07T09-01-26-415Z (D595) -- the first run through the instrument D594 fixed, which is why it supersedes the phase-5 close medians of 2026-08-27 that stood here before. Flag rule: D273 +/-20% on M1b/M1c/M3a; M1a is a VOID channel on this machine (BASELINE §3b verdict) and is reported informationally. TWO CELLS ARE NOT FROM THIS RUN. bklit/composed/1000 was not in the run's cell set and keeps its docs/phase-5/BASELINE.md §3b medians. migrated/scatter/1000.m1b_settleMs keeps the phase-5 1258.6. It was HELD there because the 7.6 run measured 2505.3 and that was read as a 1.98x regression against the same-run bklit control (1266.3). D630 shows it was not a regression: migrated ScatterChart never emitted a non-ready phase, so armBklitSettle (bench/app/src/bench/settle.ts:47-55) never resolved and the 2500 ms FALLBACK_MS carried the measurement -- which is what the p95 of 2506 over 7 samples was saying. 97e2967 makes the reveal observable; Gate 4 measures 1183.6, -6.0% against this value and inside the flag band. THE HOLD IS LIFTED and the value stands on its own merits; no adoption was needed. Note when reading M1c deltas: every control cell (bklit and tanstack alike) rose 11-19% between the phase-5 run and this one, a uniform machine/browser shift, so migrated's larger rises are roughly 25-35% net of it, not the raw figure. consoleErrorCount baselines: legacy bklit/bar/1000 and /10000 emit negative-<rect>-attribute errors (rx/ry/width) in the Phase-5 close run itself (514742 / 1540000) -- inherited legacy behaviour, gated on increase only (D500). m3c_tooltipAppeared baseline: legacy bklit/line/1000 is false in every recorded run. THREE VALUES ARE MEDIANS OF THREE RUNS, NOT THIS RUN. tanstack/bar/100.m1b, tanstack/scatter/1000.m1b and tanstack/scatter/1000.m1c vary between runs by more than the 20% flag band (56.6%, 26.2%, 24.2% between the 7.6 and Gate 2 runs), so a single run cannot serve as their baseline -- adopting one would guarantee a false flag on the next. They carry the median of phase-5, 7.6 and Gate 2, which in each case is the phase-5 value because that figure was itself median-derived. Regenerate by hand only when a new baseline is formally adopted (D-entry).
